test_title: PYST 02: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - GA (Held On: 05 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In April 2025, India and China initiated discussions to resume direct passenger flights that had been suspended since which year?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2020**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• India and China suspended direct passenger flights in **2020** due to the outbreak of the COVID-19 pandemic.
 
• The suspension of flights was part of global measures to curb the spread of the coronavirus, which disrupted international air travel.
 
• Discussions to resume flights began in April 2025, signaling efforts to normalize ties and strengthen bilateral relations.
 
• Several countries including India and China implemented travel restrictions in 2020, affecting passenger movement across borders.
 
• The resumption of flights is expected to enhance people-to-people connectivity and foster economic collaboration between the two nations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **COVID-19 Pandemic and Air Travel:**

 
 
• The COVID-19 pandemic caused widespread disruption in global air travel starting in early 2020.
 
• Many countries imposed travel bans and restrictions to prevent the spread of the virus.
 
• Passenger flights were suspended between India and China as a precautionary measure.
 
• Restoring international flights required coordination between governments, airlines, and health authorities.
 
 
 
• **India-China Relations:**
 
 
• India and China are major trading partners, with bilateral trade exceeding $100 billion annually.
 
• Resuming flights is expected to improve ties and facilitate business and cultural exchanges.
 
• Both nations have faced challenges in their relationship, including border tensions.
 
• Efforts to resume flights reflect a step toward normalization and cooperation.
 
 
 
• **Impact of Flight Suspensions:**
 
 
• Suspending flights disrupted tourism, trade, and student movement between countries.
 
• China is a popular destination for Indian students pursuing higher education, particularly in medicine.
 
• Indian businesses rely on imports from China, which were affected by the travel restrictions.
 
• Restoring flights can help mitigate the economic impact of prolonged disruptions.
 
 
 
• **International Travel Resumption Post-Pandemic:**
 
 
• Many countries gradually resumed international air travel starting in 2021 with strict health protocols.
 
• Mandatory testing, quarantine, and vaccination requirements became commonplace.
 
• Airlines adapted to new guidelines to ensure passenger safety and compliance.
 
• Resumption of flights between India and China marks a significant milestone in post-pandemic recovery.
